limitations: Volume is prescribed; changes in R/C change required pressure, not predicted tidal-volume response to fixed muscle effort.
Symmetric imposed cycle is not a quantitative passive-expiration or chest-wall model.
Gas conductance uses relative units and initial gradients; no transient blood equilibration or patient flux is calculated.
Hill relation is empirical equilibrium, not kinetic binding; presentation clock sweeps pressure.
Full oxygen content/delivery and carbon dioxide integration deferred to Chapter8; no clinical SpO2 algorithm or treatment advice.
FeIII source label is real visible slide content; mixed electronic descriptions distinguished from methemoglobin formation using primary spectroscopy.
Original schematics are uncalibrated; separate actual SEM supplies prepared-tissue context without measured airway geometry or photorealistic-render validation.
Blocked/partial NCBI endpoints not counted as full reads; actual alternatives and limits stated in source appendix.
coverage_basis: All23 mapped topic dispositions plus substantive later lung functions and six solutions assessed in both full reviews. Source evidence is complete captions plus attributed bounded still audit, not continuous video/audio.

production_validation.scope: Historical actual production evidence plus current scientific-artifact identity and a separate bounded current reader reinspection.
